description.zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
description.en: The `token` that is used to initiate the next request. If the response of the current request is truncated, you can use the token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records.

description.zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务](~~450526~~)。
description.en:
The type of the shared resources.

For more information about the types of resources that can be shared, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing](~~450526~~).

title.zh: 查询默认共享权限信息

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，在`cn-hangzhou`地域，查询资源类型为`VSwitch`的默认共享权限信息。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the information about the default permission for the `VSwitch` resource type in the `cn-hangzhou` region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing list-permissions --resource-type VSwitch --max-results 20 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcesharing ListPermissions --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --MaxResults 20 --ResourceType VSwitch
